cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Prosperity ≠ poverty – the state of being successful and flourishing.

p.em: Example: The red colour symbolizes prosperity.

cosy-blockquote.p: Tradition – the transmission of customs from generation to generation.

p.em: Example: It is a tradition to have a big family dinner.

cosy-blockquote.p: Ritual – a religious or solemn ceremony consisting of a series of actions.

p.em: Example: Cleaning the house before the New Year is a common ritual.

cosy-blockquote.p: Symbolize – to be a symbol of something.

p.em: Example: Firecrackers symbolize scaring away evil spirits.

cosy-blockquote.p: Ancestor – a person from whom one is descended.

p.em: Example: Many people pay respects to their ancestors during the festival.
Example: The Lunar New Year is the most important festival in China.

cosy-blockquote.p: Lunar – determined by or resembling the moon.

p.em: Example: The date is based on the lunar calendar.

cosy-blockquote.p: Zodiac – a belt of the heavens within which are the paths of the sun, moon, and planets.

p.em: Example: Each year is associated with a zodiac animal.

cosy-blockquote.p: Reunion – the act of coming together again.

p.em: Example: The reunion dinner is the highlight of the celebration.

cosy-blockquote.p: Offering – a thing offered, especially as a gift or contribution.

p.em: Example: Fruit offerings are placed on the family altar.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
How does the intense focus on welcoming financial prosperity, which is associated with the color red, affect modern families' expectations?
★ Is it common to see these celebrations in your city?

Why do young people sometimes struggle to rely on family tradition during large cultural holidays?
★ Do you prefer holidays with fixed or changing dates?

Why does a simple yearly ritual, celebrated in many Asian countries, have such a powerful emotional effect?
★ What is the "lucky color" in your culture?

Red envelopes symbolize a shift in luck and protection; what other holiday gifts carry deep symbolic meanings?
★ When was the last time you received money as a gift?

Why is honoring one's ancestors, which is famous for bringing blessings, a central pillar of Lunar New Year?
★ Do you know your family history or have special stories about your grandparents?

How has this ancient agricultural festival, celebrated on a changing lunar date, evolved to become a global celebration?
★ What is the most important "holiday food" in your family?

Why does following a lunar calendar, famous for its seasonal rhythm, create a unique feeling compared to solar calendars?
★ Do you usually do a big "spring cleaning" before major holidays?

How does the 12-year animal zodiac cycle, associated with specific personality traits, influence people's future choices?
★ Do you know your zodiac animal, and do you think its description fits you?

Why is the traditional family reunion dinner, famous for bringing relatives together, considered the most sacred part of the holiday?
★ Could you imagine traveling long distances just to have a single dinner with your family?

What is the spiritual significance of placing a food offering on a family altar during festive periods?
★ Do you like traveling or staying home during the holidays?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: 🐉 Activity 1: The Chinese Zodiac Affinity Chart Each zodiac animal carries traits that people rely on. Together with your partner, evaluate these three iconic signs. Decide which sign's values are most critical for overcoming modern-day societal stress. Focus on correct prepositional usage (associated with, rely on, famous for): 🐉 The Dragon Associated with absolute charisma, strength, and visionary ambition. 🐇 The Rabbit Famous for deep diplomacy, gentle peace, and emotional sensitivity. 🐂 The Ox People rely on its silent resilience, hard work, and loyalty. 🏮 Closing: The Lantern Wish Ceremony As the spring festival closes, we release paper lanterns to carry our hopes into the sky. If you could release one lantern with a single wish for your family, which hope would you prioritize? 📈 Enduring Financial Prosperity ❤️ Harmonious Relationships & Unity 🍏 Robust Health & Long Life ✈️ Safe Journeys & New Adventures

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
Digital 'red envelopes' wishing prosperity, associated with instant transfers, will completely replace physical ones.
★ Do you feel wishing someone prosperity via a digital transfer is as meaningful as physical envelopes?

As families disperse globally, we will rely on virtual reunion dinners rather than physical reunions.
★ Have you ever celebrated a major family reunion over a video call?

In the future, young generations will completely lose connection to family ritual practices, celebrated on traditional days.
★ Do you follow any traditional ritual that you secretly find silly?

Major holidays will become purely commercial events driven by shopping festival sales, famous for huge discounts.
★ Do you think a modern shopping festival has replaced the true spirit of traditional holidays?

In the future, the globalized world will rely on a single calendar, making any traditional lunar calendar obsolete.
★ Do you think we should follow a lunar calendar, or do you prefer a standard solar calendar?

Future smart cities will ban all physical offering tables, famous for incense burning, to reduce pollution.
★ Would you support a ban on physical offering burning if it made city air cleaner?

The psychological belief in zodiac signs, associated with ancient astrology, will be treated as a cognitive bias.
★ Do you know your zodiac animal sign, and do you think it describes your personality?

The concept of respecting each ancestor will rely on creating digital AI clones to consult during holidays.
★ Would you want to consult an AI clone of a deceased ancestor?

Traditional foods, famous for their history, will lose their power to symbolize a shift in the seasons.
★ Which holiday dish has the best power to symbolize your family roots?

Keeping any ancient family tradition, celebrated in modern times, will be viewed as a toxic burden.
★ Do you ever feel pressured by the need to continue a family tradition?

ul.li: Incorrect: I didn't went to the parade → Correct: I didn't go to the parade ((Past simple negative))
Incorrect: In the China they celebrate it → Correct: In China they celebrate it ((No "the" with countries))
Incorrect: I am interested to Chinese culture → Correct: I am interested in Chinese culture ((Interested in))
Incorrect: If they would win, they would be happy → Correct: If they won, they would be happy ((Second conditional))
Incorrect: I am agree with you → Correct: I agree with you ((Verb agreement))
